data.body: Tauri plugin versions must match on both sides: `tauri build` refuses to start when the JS package and the Rust crate differ in major/minor. tauri-plugin-clipboard-manager is pinned to 2.3.3 on both sides (desktop/package.json exactly "2.3.3", Cargo.toml "2.3.3") because the Rust 2.4.0 requires tauri ^2.12 while the app locks tauri 2.11.5 and @tauri-apps/api 2.11.1 — so bumping that crate alone also means bumping tauri, wry and tao. The same trap applies to every other @tauri-apps/plugin-* dependency that carries a caret range while its Rust crate is pinned (currently plugin-opener). Repair a mismatch by naming one release on both sides, never by widening a range. Fixed in a3bb0ff after the 2.4.0/2.3.3 mismatch broke the build.
